name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1506: The sigil pill carried three identifiers where Konyo wanted one word - a generated crest name, a four-char code and a hostname - so it is now the crest glyph plus the NICKNAME and nothing else, with every other identifier one hover away in the tooltip. An unnamed machine says name me instead of wearing a hostname as if it were a name. That shrank the pill from 340px to 125px, which as a side effect un-swallowed the TV-D tab: the strip now fits fully at 1470 and at 1280. The board stops repeating the crest in its search row while inside the console, and the OWNER THIS PC switch is retired - it existed because the world was guessed from the operating system and a human had to override the guess, and since v1499 the claim decides it.
